title: Gate ledger-owned source regions on emitted prose or structured equivalents
description:
Finding source:
- Fable found rule:skills dropped post-list prose even though source coverage considered the region owned by rule:skills.
- This proves unaccounted=0 is insufficient when owner assignment does not prove emitted content.

Acceptance criteria:
- Extend source-region/source-coverage gates so owned body prose must appear in emitted record prose or an explicit structured equivalent.
- Handle embedded list/table interruption cases.
- Add regression fixture modeled on rule:skills p. 77-78.
- Reports should distinguish owned-but-unemitted from truly represented.
close_reason: PR #395: source-region ledger emission proofs. Every owned (record:/child-of:) prose region must prove emission: full-body containment, bullet-aware sentence containment (handles embedded list/table interruption), machine-proven label-block coverage against the target record's structured fields + reviewed label vocabulary, or a reviewed STRUCTURED_EQUIVALENT_REGIONS entry. unemitted fails assertSourceRegionLedger closed; report distinguishes owned-but-unemitted from truly represented via summary.ownedEmission. Regression fixture modeled on rule:skills p.77-78 added. Gate immediately caught real truncation: wrapped meta lines dropped Werebear neutral-good/Werewolf chaotic-evil/Bandit(+Captain) alignments; parseCreatures fixed, pack regenerated.
